_comment: Row 341 transform controls. These are the five byte-identical production transforms from the primary battery, but the only selected spec merely imports/collects this test module and checks an unrelated guard-pin contract. Every transform must ESCAPE, proving the primary CAUGHT verdicts come from the new READY/artifact assertions rather than shell syntax, Python collection, or an always-failing test module.
subject: transform-only controls for cloud provisioning artifact regressions

mutants.label: TC1 optional GUI generation transform under unrelated import control
TC2 permissive route-source transform under unrelated import control
TC3 non-failing read-back transform under unrelated import control
TC4 npm-ci warning transform under unrelated import control
mutants.old:
if ! ( cd frontend && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund ); then
  echo "FATAL: frontend dependency installation failed"
  exit 1
fi
mutants.new: ( cd frontend && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund ) || echo "WARN: frontend deps failed"

mutants.label: TC5 omitted SPA build transform under unrelated import control
mutants.old:
if ! ( cd frontend && npm run build ); then
  echo "FATAL: frontend SPA build failed"
  exit 1
fi
if [ ! -f frontend/dist/index.html ]; then
  echo "FATAL: npm run build exited 0 but frontend/dist/index.html is absent"
  exit 1
fi
echo "frontend bundle: frontend/dist/index.html present"
